Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public. 




Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan 
"The Right to Information, The Right to Live"

Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
DESCENDERS FOR MOUNTAINEERING 



1. Scope — Covers the requirements for descenders for mountaineering. 

2. Dimensions 

Ail dimensions in millimetres. 



WELDED 




WELDED. 



^ 



3. Material —The descenders shall be manufactured from steel conforming to T50 of IS : 3749-1966 
'Specification for tool and die steels for cold work '. 

4. Hardness — Descenders shall be hardened and tempered to a hardness range of 300 to 400 HV, 

5. Mass — The mass of the descenders shall be 190 g, Max. 

6. Workmanship and Finish — The descenders shall be free from defects, such as burrs, cracks, 
scales and any other foreign depositions. 

6.1 The descenders shall be given any one of the following anti-corrosion treatment: 

a) Nickel and chromium plating to service Grade No. 2 of IS: 1068-1968 'Specification for 
electroplated coatings of nickel and chromium on iron and steel ( first revision ) \ 

b) Cadmium coating to service condition No. 2 of IS : 1572-1968 'Specification for electro- 
plated coatings of cadmium on iron and steel (first revision) 1 . 



Adopted 26 March 1979

7. Tests— Each descender shall be subjected to proof load test as shown in Fig. 1; and the mini- 
mum load shall be 12 kN.

8. Marking — Each descender shall be legibly and indelibly stamped or marked with the manufac- 
turer's name, initials or recognized trade-mark and the year of manufacture. 

8.1 ISI Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

While preparing the standard assistance has been derived from the drawing on the subject 
issued by the Defence Materials and Stores Research and Development Establishment, Kanpur.
